data.age: Age of Discovery, after the Age of Renaissance

title: Al-Andalus claims the title of Cultural Hegemon as the renewed Andalusī golden age continues

The New World institution appears in the world, and its origin is Ishbīliya. No new world has been found yet, but the culture of exploration and expeditions, backed by the crown, has taken root in the capital
